description: Expanded synthetic stress suite: single and multiple nutrient differences, under/overstatements, boundary errors, portions and servings. Previously inspected held-out food identities; not an independent real-AI benchmark.
limitations: Synthetic rule labels, not independent expert labels.
Perfect scores are possible; no errors or label noise are injected to force lower metrics.
Coverage is separate from accuracy; abstentions are not counted as correct binary predictions.
Do not tune on this suite and then present it as unseen evaluation.
